statement: For every normalized GT0 involution alpha=(-1,f), its exact coboundary can be chosen as f=h^-1 alpha(h), with h in F' and h theta(h)=1. All triangle-surviving tuples in D38's universal A5 quotient admit the corresponding finite first-symmetry solution.
notes: The semidirect extension is explicitly defined with Theta(s)=f*s, and every normalizer-to-V4 map is proved injective and surjective. The three-class triangle determines the unique fixed section class. This solves the first symmetry together with the coboundary; the third-cusp generation/conjugacy equation remains exactly D35. The finite test adds no exclusion beyond D38's triangle test and asserts no full lift of finite candidates.
